key_insight: Physics residuals are good at telling you when a CFD surrogate is wrong, but not at telling you how to correct it.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast surrogate CFD with an added self-auditing trust layer and a learned corrector for safer deployment on new flow cases.
method: Compute the discretized steady-RANS residual of surrogate predictions.
Use residuals for calibrated trust via split conformal prediction and deep-ensemble uncertainty.
Train a supervised deep-equilibrium corrector toward ground truth for self-correction.
evidence_signal: Across three backbones and a second dataset, residual-error rank correlation stays positive (e.g., Transolver 0.625±0.019, MeshGraphNet 0.851±0.058), while conformal coverage hits 0.902±0.008 at a 0.90 target.
watch_item: The correction benefit is backbone-dependent, and the coverage guarantee only holds under exchangeability.
paper_title: NeuroForge: A Self-Correcting, Geometry-Native Neural CFD Engine with Calibrated Physics-Residual Trust
